steps.en: Install the skill into your agent
steps.zh: 把 skill 装进你的 agent

steps.en: Loads automatically whenever a task touches UI polish — the frontmatter is stuffed with trigger cues
steps.zh: 任务一碰到 UI 打磨就自动加载——frontmatter 描述里写满了触发词

steps.en: Build the UI as usual, or ask it to review the diff just written
steps.zh: 照常做界面，或让它 review 刚写好的 diff

steps.en: Applies its 19 numbered principles in the project's existing styling system, never a second one
steps.zh: 用项目已有的样式体系落实 19 条编号原则，绝不引入第二套

steps.en: Walks every state and replays motion at 10% speed, then returns severity-tagged findings
steps.zh: 逐个状态过一遍、动画按 10% 速度重放，按严重级别输出发现

value.en: Functionally-correct UI comes out feeling intentional without hand-writing a polish checklist per prompt
value.zh: 功能正确的界面交付时显得有意为之，而不用你每条 prompt 手写一遍打磨清单

sources: skills/make-interfaces-feel-better/SKILL.md frontmatter description: 'Use when building UI components, reviewing frontend code ... Supports quick and full review modes. Triggers on UI polish ... "make it feel better", "feels off" ...'
SKILL.md opening: 'express the change in that system: Tailwind in a Tailwind project ... Never introduce a second styling system just to apply a polish fix'
SKILL.md 'When reviewing': 'replay motion at 10% speed ... walk every state: hover, focus, active, loading, empty'
SKILL.md 'Review Output Format': quick / full modes with HIGH/MEDIUM/LOW severities
